page.title: Amenities
page.description: Weekly consumption control per area, amenities warehouse and Spa towels.

board.title: Weekly controls
board.description: One control per area and week. The area supervisor prepares it, the general supervisor reviews it and the Operations Manager acknowledges it.

form.title: Area and week
form.description: The system calculates opening stock, supplied and extras; enter the final stock counted in carts and linen rooms.
form.pick: Pick an area to calculate the week.
form.exists: A control for that week already exists ({{folio}}).

sheet.formula: Real = initial + supplied − final. Expected = occupied × standard + extras. Difference % = (real − expected) ÷ expected.
sheet.noLines: There are no items with a standard or movement that week.

lowStock.title: Amenities warehouse below minimum
lowStock.description: Consumable products in the AME warehouse at or below their minimum.
lowStock.none: No product is at its minimum.

spa.title: Spa today
spa.description: Spa towels: delivered by laundry, dirty returned, in use and shortage.

pdf.title: Weekly amenities control per area
pdf.formula: Real consumption = initial stock + supplied − final stock (carts and area linen room). Expected consumption = occupied rooms × standard + registered extras. Difference % = (real − expected) ÷ expected. Above 10% it is reviewed with the area supervisor and reported to the Operations Manager.
